$comment: Website paths the Sureground app opens when a link to them is tapped on a phone with the app installed (iOS universal links, Android app links). Read by apps/mobile/app.config.js (Android intent filters) and apps/web (apple-app-site-association). The app's lib/deepLinks.ts must handle every prefix listed in `claimed`; paths under `webOnly` are claimed implicitly by a prefix but have no screen in the app, so iOS excludes them and the app hands them back to the browser.
